message: stream-condition $request.stream requires a JSON request body, but endpoint missingRequestBody has none, so Fern generates its streaming and non-streaming endpoints without a request body to select between them.

stream-condition $request.stream requires the JSON request body to be an object schema with properties; Fern drops a request body that is not, so endpoint arrayRequestBody would lose its request body.
